requirementFit.summary: The 15-file write-set covers every plan item without excess; _all.scss needs no edits; the viewport meta exists; mixins.scss correctly excluded.

implementationQuality.summary: Round 1 returned three load-bearing textual findings, all closed verbatim: the time/showDate wiring through messenger.hbs (without it the stage would silently not render), NaN-safe formatting (an invalid time must render without time/marker and never throw — RangeError would kill the whole messenger), and the complete mobile-switch mechanics including the Messenger prop whitelist lesson (LIVE-7) and the scope guard protecting the co-located li.chat-history status row from bubble-style shortcuts.

evidenceQuality.summary: Deterministic component tests gate sides/time/day-markers; playwright receipts gate geometry (scrollWidth, bubble centers, back click); screenshots are honestly scoped as operator-review artifacts; the budget advisory on screenshot bytes noted.

residualRisk.summary: Formatting is view-side only; no router/store/data changes; of the 186 existing tests nothing can break (verified against the messenger/chat test contents); desktop geometry pinned by AC-UI-3.

rounds.summary: Three findings: F1 MAJOR (time/showDate never reach the Message helper in messenger.hbs; the HH:MM formatter and day computation are not NaN-safe — Intl throws RangeError on an invalid date and one bad fixture would kill the render); F2 MEDIUM (the message list also hosts the li.chat-history status row — bubble styles must not touch it via bare li selectors or container align-items/gap); F3 MEDIUM (the mobile switch mechanics were under-specified: chatPaneOpen transitions, the onBack wiring through the Messenger constructor whitelist, the back button default-hidden desktop-first, delete-chat behavior). Architecture, write-set, AC/EV and the test plan were verified sound against the code.

Closure round per the reviewer's explicit pre-approval: all three findings fixed verbatim in plan.md (wiring step, NaN-safety requirement with the invalid-time test case, the full switch-mechanics paragraph, the status-row scope guard); no other plan content changed. Digest unchanged because the manifest itself was untouched; the lock inventory pins the revised plan.md.
